protocol: official train/validation/test splits; each variant changes one factor relative to the full configuration; same training seeds; full-configuration numbers are the main benchmark runs
top_baseline_selection: highest mean validation AUROC among supervised models other than the Tabular Transformer; the test split is not used for this choice
causal_jitter_definition: causal_jitter_s[i] = |dt[i] - mean(dt[j] for j in 1..i-1)|, where dt[j] is the positive inter-arrival time (receive_time_ns difference / 1e9) of the same sender within the current official split; the running mean is cumulative since the last history reset (a gap > max_gap_seconds) and the feature is masked until one prior interval exists
local_density_definition: number of distinct senders, including the focal sender itself, whose latest position observed within the trailing local_window_seconds lies within local_radius_meters of the focal position (so the minimum valid value is 1)

coordinate_representation.description: Translation-invariant displacement, vertical step, speed change, and heading change replaced by absolute position x, y, z and absolute heading

timing_and_jitter.description: Inter-arrival time, causal jitter, duplicate-timestamp, and long-gap indicators removed

validity_masks.description: Missing values imputed as the normalized benign median (zero) with no feature-validity or step-padding mask supplied to the model

one_class_window_length.description: Isolation forest and one-class SVM fit on the same flattened L = 10 window and validity masks as the supervised baselines (one-class SVM on a seeded sample of at most 10,000 non-malicious training records); compared with their current-step (L = 1) versions in the main benchmark

autoencoder_checkpoint_selection.description: LSTM autoencoder trained on non-malicious training sequences exactly as in the main benchmark, but the checkpoint is the epoch with the lowest mean masked reconstruction error on non-malicious validation records; no attacker record or attacker-versus-benign metric is used for training or checkpoint selection. The main lstm_autoencoder selects its checkpoint by validation AUROC. Alert thresholds of both remain validation-F1 thresholds.
